# The Clinical Perspective

> A free, independently maintained record of which clinical psychology doctoral faculty are accepting new students for Fall 2027, alongside plain-language summaries of peer-reviewed mental health research. No account, no paywall, no adverts.

Last updated 2026-10-23. The figures below are written by the build from the site's own data, not maintained by hand.

## Accepting-students tracker

- [Who's accepting doctoral students](https://theclinicalperspective.org/tools/faculty-accepting-students.html): 511 faculty confirmed accepting across 100 programs that have published a list, from 258 programs at 243 institutions checked so far. Marked up as schema.org Dataset and ItemList.
- [Search faculty by research interest](https://theclinicalperspective.org/tools/professor-search.html): 2681 faculty, each interest quoted from their own university page.
- [All programs](https://theclinicalperspective.org/programs/): one page per program, with deadlines, GRE requirements, APA outcome disclosures and the faculty marked up as schema.org Person.
- [Faculty by research topic](https://theclinicalperspective.org/professors/): the same faculty grouped by what they study.

## How the tracker is compiled

- Every faculty name is read from that program's own admissions or faculty page, and the sentence it came from is quoted on the entry beside the date it was read.
- Names are never taken from search-engine results or third-party lists. In testing, search under-reported UCLA as 3 faculty where the program's page listed 7, and FIU as 6 where it listed 11.
- Programs are re-checked every two days through the autumn, and corrections are logged on the entry with their date rather than edited away.
- "Cohort admission" marks programs that admit to the incoming class and assign an advisor afterwards, so no mentor list exists to publish.

## What this does not cover

- A program absent from the tracker has **not been checked yet**. It does not mean nobody there is accepting.
- A faculty member absent from a program's list is absent from the program's own published list. Some programs publish no list at all.
- Lists change through the cycle. The date on each entry is the date that page was last read, and is the right thing to cite alongside the claim.
- Nothing here is admissions advice, and no part of it is endorsed by the programs it describes.

## Research summaries

- [Research archive](https://theclinicalperspective.org/research.html): 101 peer-reviewed studies summarised in plain language, most recent 2026-10-22. Each links to the paper and names its journal, DOI and PMID.
- [Guides](https://theclinicalperspective.org/guides/): longer explainers on questions that recur.

## Reuse

- The accepting-students tracker is published under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): quote it, republish it or build on it, including commercially, with credit to The Clinical Perspective and a link back. No permission needed.
- That covers the compilation — which programs were checked, which faculty each names, the status recorded and the dates the pages were read. It does not cover the sentences quoted from each program's own page, which are those institutions' words, nor the research summaries, which are separate. [Full scope](https://theclinicalperspective.org/legal.html#tracker-licence).
- Please carry the date shown on an entry alongside any figure taken from it.
